title: SKG-Eval：基于增量语义知识图谱的多轮对话状态评估
summary: 提出SKG-Eval框架，通过构建增量语义知识图谱（SKG）来建模多轮对话中的实体、关系和承诺，从而评估对话质量。该框架计算局部相关性、历史一致性和逻辑连贯性三个信号，并自适应融合为会话评分。实验表明，该方法在长对话中能更好地检测矛盾、主题漂移等长程问题，且结果可解释、可复现。
summary_en: Proposes SKG-Eval, a quasi-deterministic framework that models multi-turn dialogue as an evolving Semantic Knowledge Graph (SKG) to evaluate response quality. It computes local relevance, historical consistency, and logical coherence signals, adaptively fused into a session score. Achieves higher correlation with human judgments and better detection of long-range inconsistencies.
